Hey,

Hope your week is going well! Just passing along a few things we wanted you to know about.

You may notice a new letterhead on our documents; nothing else about them changes. When unloading, the cartons should stay upright and off any damp floor. We now use a lighter pallet film; please avoid stacking pallets more than two high.

No need to write back, this is purely for your information. Thanks, and talk soon.

Kofi
Halcyon Textiles
